description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked and Shipped from LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Bolt Kit for the Front Brake Caliper Assembly.
These Bolts connect the two halves of the Brake Calipers together.
Takes 2 Bolts per Caliper
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Bolts, Brake Caliper
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985- 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980- 1984 All Models
Holden Drover
Suzuki Sierra
